title: Thunkable Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Thunkable is a mature drag-and-drop native builder, but it allows one live app on Builder, expires testing downloads in 72 hours, and relies on external data. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform.
body_markdown: Per Thunkable's FAQ, private projects go read-only, and downgrading to Free can put projects in read-only mode with possible deletion after long inactivity. With Blink, your code sits in your own GitHub repo.
